newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bunds higher, but showing scant volatility.
newsitem.headline: Bunds higher, but showing scant volatility.

text.p: German Bund futures were higher in late trade after spending the day drifting in a 22 basis point range influenced mostly by the U.S. market.

With few domestic events emerging that could have left an impact on the market, Bund traders looked to Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony to the U.S. senate to provide the market with direction. But by late in the day, Greenspan had not mentioned economic conditions.
The DTB March Bund futures contract was up 23 basis points at 101.28, in the middle of a range between 101.17 to 101.39.
"There is not much to report, we are hanging on the U.S. market. And this afternoon with no important numbers due, we are again in a relatively narrow range," one trader said.
The only domestic event on the market's mind was not scheduled to happen until after the market closed when Chancellor Helmut Kohl was scheduled to meet Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar.
Bund traders looked to the meeting for comments from Kohl on if he would approve of Spain's entry into the first group of European monetary union members.
Such comments would further narrow yield spreads between Bunds and other high-yielding bond markets.
T-notes outperformed Bunds late in the day after the U.S. helped wanted index was released. The spread narrowed two basis points to 91 basis points.
Traders said they see Bunds continuing to drift sideways until there is a fundamental shift in the economic picture.
Indeed, few are betting the contract will soon test the 102.07 high and said that the 101.60 level, the January 23 high, will limit gains at least until U.S. GDP data is released on Friday afternoon.
Analysts see support for the Bund futures contract at around 101.05. That level marks trendline support from the June 17 low of 94.59.
There was also little change to the shape of the German yield curve with the spread between two- and 10-year maturities widening a single basis point to 237 basis ponts.
